messages:
alex_m: heads-up — sketching a new per-route PII strategy: hierarchical hashing + quota-aware sampling. want quick feedback before RFC.

maria_g: curious — why hierarchical hash? how's this different from our sticky-sampler approach?

alex_m: two layers: 1) stable fingerprint (tenant-scoped HMAC) to dedupe and tie audits; 2) stateless stratified sampler per-request for telemetry budgets. goal: auditability without storing raw fields.

suresh_k: nice. console needs to show sample rates + a 'PII risk' score per route. ops should be able to override per-tenant.

jen_ops: retention caveat: audits require >=90d for sampled traces. need TTL labels and per-dataset retention configs.

alex_m: agreed — default TTLs: debug=30d, audit=90d. samples carry encrypted metadata, keys in KMS/HSM.

telemetry-bot: ingest-pipeline: applied canary sampling config -> route=chat.generate sample_rate=0.01

maria_g: embeddings are tricky — hashed embeddings can leak via similarity. propose we strip high-entropy tokens or run token-level masking before hash.

alex_m: good call. will run eval with embeddings team. also plan to store prompt template + token_counts instead of full prompt text.

suresh_k: how do quotas/backpressure work? if we increase sample rate, telemetry downstream could blow up.

alex_m: gate forwarding with per-tenant token-buckets and a budget surface in console. if budget exceeded, degrade to metadata-only traces and emit an event.

jen_ops: rollout plan: canary 1% tenants -> console toggle at route-level -> escalation policy to auto-roll-back on 'PII-exposure' alerts. add a replay mode for investigations.

maria_g: about salts: tenant-specific salt + periodic rotation? what about cross-tenant correlation for fraud detection?

alex_m: tenant-specific HMAC-SHA256 with KMS-backed key per-account. rotation window 90d; we keep rotation metadata to re-hash if needed for audits.

suresh_k: perf note: HMAC per-request has CPU cost — maybe offload to a lightweight native lib or do async tagging. cc @eng-runtime

alex_m: agreed; we'll prototype a C-extension and fallback to async worker for heavy routes.

alex_m: config sketch:
```
sampling:
  routes:
    chat.generate:
      stratified_rate: 0.01
      stable_fingerprint: true
      fingerprint_method: hmac-sha256
      retention: 90d
      backoff_policy: token_bucket(1000/s)
```

jen_ops: :thumbsup: looks reasonable. next step: RFC + perf microbench + dashboard mockups.

maria_g: I'll mock up the dashboard slices (sample rate heatmap + budget burn rate) by EOW.

suresh_k: I'll check cost estimates and perf impact.

telemetry-bot: note: RFC draft created -> /docs/rfcs/pii-hierarchical-sampling.md
